MASTER-OAGH robotic telescope  [1]  located in Mexico (OAGH National Institute for Astrophysics, Optics and Electronics) started inspect of the Fermi GRB 260421C ( Fermi GBM team, GCN 44369) errorbox  165 sec after notice time and 186 sec after trigger time at 2026-04-21 08:28:26 UT, with upper limit up to  20.5 mag. The observations began at zenith distance = 51 deg. The sun  altitude  is -43.9 deg. 

The galactic latitude b = 19 deg., longitude l = 96 deg.


Real time updated cover map and OT discovered available here: 
https://master.sai.msu.ru/site/master2/observ.php?id=3263342
